label: Universal causes with HAS_INTELLECT_1 and HAS_WILL_1 give by rational exercise at w
paraphrase: For every g with HAS_INTELLECT_1 and HAS_WILL_1 that causes the being of every other being in act as to esse, and each such distinct effect x, g gives x being at w by exercising an owned rational power. This is the agency-overlay sense of through will. The type does not establish practical determination by apprehended content, recipient-directed willing or freedom to refrain.
